remarks: Live above it all at 1 Strawberry Hill Avenue, Unit 9G-a sun-splashed, renovated 2BR/2BA condo with a private balcony showcasing sweeping Stamford views and gorgeous Fall foliage. The airy layout features a spacious living/dining area that opens to the private balcony, an updated kitchen, two generous bedrooms, and two refreshed full baths. Convenience is built in with one reserved parking space (option to rent a second) plus a dedicated 4x4 storage unit. Resort-style amenities elevate daily living: 24-hour doorman, library, two exercise rooms, sauna, and a heated in-ground pool. Commuters will love the proximity to I-95 and Stamford Main Station for both Metro-North and Amtrak. Downtown dining, shopping, and entertainment are moments away-yet 9G provides a calm, luxurious retreat above the city. Non-smoking, well-maintained building. Good credit is a must. Experience skyline living with everyday convenience-schedule your private tour of Unit 9G today!
